**Daily Devotional**

**May 15**

*36 As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe. (Mark 5:36 KJV)*

This is where Jesus and Jairus had just been told that Jairus’s daughter had died as they were going to Jairus’s home to cure her of sickness. Notice that Jesus told Jairus to “only believe”, indicating that you can believe and yet have unbelief at the same time. Most Christians have not realized that both faith and unbelief can exist at the same time in your heart (Mark 9:24). Jesus many times in the bible could not do many healings and miracles because of people’s unbelief (Matthew 13:58). That shows that we cannot have the power of God flow through us, when there is a lot of unbelief present. Jesus had to put out those people that were not in faith, to be able to heal the sick and raise the dead (Mark 5:40).

To have the power of God active in your life, you must have faith and not have unbelief. All of us Christians have the very faith of Jesus living in us through the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23), so we have faith, but we also have a lot of unbelief in our hearts, as the world pumps unbelief into our homes through radio and television all day every day. To have your faith work for you, you must control the amount of unbelief that you are exposed to. Stay in the Word of God, and not in the worldly affairs, at all times, and your faith will work wonders for you (Matthew 17:20). Help me Lord to stay focused on you.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
